# Strudel AI Visual Coder

> Image-to-Strudel live coding workspace for AI-assisted visual music performance.

Strudel AI Visual Coder is a desktop web app that turns an uploaded image into executable Strudel code, track-level pianoroll and waveform widgets, AI-selected sound packs, semantic vocal chops, and audio-reactive WebGL shader visuals.

## Primary URL

- https://strudel.n2f.site

## Source and Examples

- Source code: https://github.com/lux-02/Strudel
- Examples: https://www.instagram.com/new.here.hero/

## What It Does

- Analyzes an uploaded image for color, contrast, texture, motion cues, emotion, composition, and spatial density.
- Generates Strudel code with labeled tracks such as `$DRUMS`, `$BASS`, `$MEL`, `$SYNTH`, `$LIGHT`, `$TEXTURE`, and optional `$VOICE`.
- Runs Strudel directly in the browser with `@strudel/web`.
- Shows track-level pianoroll and waveform feedback.
- Selects a sound pack from default, 808, and 909-oriented palettes.
- Provides Shader Modes: Filament, Plasma, Spectral, and Scanline.
- Supports Variant + Evolve, AI bridge transitions, Auto Loop, and performance countdowns.
- Optionally creates semantic vocal chops from image-derived words and morphemes.

## Intended Users

- Creative coders
- AI music tool builders
- Live coding performers
- Visual music artists
- Short-form video creators
- Strudel and TidalCycles users

## Key Technologies

- Next.js App Router
- React
- TypeScript
- CodeMirror
- @strudel/web
- @strudel/draw
- WebGL / GLSL
- OpenAI API
- Optional Kanana-compatible image and audio endpoint

## Notes for AI Assistants

When summarizing this project, describe it as an image-to-Strudel visual music tool, not as a generic AI music generator. The distinguishing features are visible live code, track-level visual widgets, AI sound pack selection, semantic vocal chops, and audio-reactive shader modes.
